text_original.description: One atomic claim (one effect on one target), ad wording
text_original.title: Text Original

text_en.description: English translation for search; not used as evidence
text_en.title: Text En

other_text.description: Prices, phone/order lines, slogans, certifications as printed
other_text.title: Other Text

rejected.description: Items dropped because their span was not found in the ad text
rejected.title: Rejected

value.description: As written in the ad (original script)
value.title: Value

name_en.description: English rendering of the name for searching; a translation, not new information
name_en.title: Name En

amount.description: Only if shown in the ad, e.g. '৬০০ মি.গ্রা.'
amount.title: Amount

scope.description: INGREDIENT or FINISHED_PRODUCT; copied from the EvidenceRecord

relevant_passage.description: The part of the evidence passage that bears on this claim
relevant_passage.title: Relevant Passage

ClaimEvidenceMatch.description: How closely a study matches what the ad actually says.

outcome.description: Study outcome vs the claimed effect

population.description: Study population vs the ad's audience

dose.description: Tested dose vs the product's dose (if known)

intervention.description: Same finished product, same ingredient form, or different

ClaimEvidenceMatch.title: ClaimEvidenceMatch

linked_ingredient_ids.description: Ingredients plausibly related to the claim's target
linked_ingredient_ids.title: Linked Ingredient Ids

research_questions.description: Questions the agent searched, in English
research_questions.title: Research Questions

finished_product_status.description: Was any FINISHED_PRODUCT evidence found for this claim?

official_material_mentions_claim.description: Does the official label/site make the same claim?
official_material_mentions_claim.title: Official Material Mentions Claim

ingredient_id.description: e.g. 'ing_01'; used by IngredientResearch and ClaimResearch
ingredient_id.title: Ingredient Id

standardized_name.description: Searchable English name, e.g. 'Gymnema sylvestre leaf extract'
standardized_name.title: Standardized Name

information_class.description: InformationClass of the best finding for this ingredient
information_class.title: Information Class

ad_mention_id.description: AdIngredient.mention_id if the ad also shows it
ad_mention_id.title: Ad Mention Id

effect.description: Proposed effect studied, e.g. 'lowers fasting blood glucose'
effect.title: Effect

summary.description: What the linked studies report, neutral; no claim judgement
summary.title: Summary

EvidenceRecord.description: One study (or registry entry) as read from its abstract or record.

subject_id.description: ingredient_id for INGREDIENT scope, product candidate id for FINISHED_PRODUCT
subject_id.title: Subject Id

result_summary.description: What the study reports, in neutral words; no judgement of the ad
result_summary.title: Result Summary

EvidenceRecord.title: EvidenceRecord

EvidenceRelation.description:
Relation of ONE source to the claim's topic, as the source states it.
This is a description of the source, not a decision about the claim.
EvidenceRelation.title: EvidenceRelation

EvidenceScope.description: Kept apart everywhere: ingredient evidence is never product evidence.
EvidenceScope.title: EvidenceScope

Finding.description: One atomic fact about the product or an ingredient, with provenance.

field.description: What the fact is about, e.g. 'ingredient', 'amount', 'manufacturer_name', 'registration_number', 'dosage', 'intended_purpose', 'warning'
field.title: Field

subject_id.description: product candidate id or ingredient_id this fact belongs to
subject_id.title: Subject Id

passage.description: Supporting text copied from the source
passage.title: Passage

Finding.title: Finding

FinishedProductResearch.description: Studies on the exact finished product. Never filled from ingredient studies.

manufacturer_claimed_studies.description: finding_ids where the manufacturer cites a study that was not independently found
manufacturer_claimed_studies.title: Manufacturer Claimed Studies

FinishedProductResearch.title: FinishedProductResearch

InformationClass.description: How a finding should be read. Shown separately in the report and to the verifier.
InformationClass.title: InformationClass

description.description: What the ingredient is, from a cited reference source
description.title: Description

evidence_ids.description: All studies found for this ingredient
evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids

tested_dose_range.description: Range of doses used in the linked human studies, as reported
tested_dose_range.title: Tested Dose Range

phase.description: identity | brand_manufacturer | official_sources | composition | ingredient | finished_product | claim | safety | validation
phase.title: Phase

MatchScores.description: 0..1 per criterion; None when the ad gives nothing to compare.
MatchScores.title: MatchScores

item.description: e.g. 'official label', 'amount of chromium picolinate', 'studies on finished product'
item.title: Item

rejected_reason.description: Why this look-alike is not the advertised product
rejected_reason.title: Rejected Reason

reasoning.description: Which evidence decided identity, in plain words
reasoning.title: Reasoning

ResearchStatus.description: Outcome of a research question. Absence of evidence is never 'false'.
ResearchStatus.title: ResearchStatus

severity_reported.description: As stated by the source, not assigned by the agent
severity_reported.title: Severity Reported

SafetySummary.description:
Cross-ingredient view for the report and later patient-risk step. References only;
the detail lives in IngredientResearch.safety.
SafetySummary.title: SafetySummary

source_id.description: Stable id within the dossier, e.g. 'src_007'
source_id.title: Source Id

publication_date.description: As given by the source, ISO when parseable
publication_date.title: Publication Date

content_hash.description: sha256 of the fetched text, so passages can be re-checked
content_hash.title: Content Hash

reliability_rank.description: 1 = most reliable; see SOURCE_RANK in the agent
reliability_rank.title: Reliability Rank

text.description: Verbatim span of the ad's OCR/transcript text
text.title: Text

Validation.description:
Checks run on every finding before it enters the dossier.

quote_in_source and value_in_passage are deterministic string checks.
refers_to_product and passage_supports_finding are semantic checks (LLM
reader with a fixed prompt, or rule) and record who made them.

quote_in_source.description: Passage found verbatim (after normalisation) in the fetched source text
quote_in_source.title: Quote In Source

value_in_passage.description: The finding's value (name, number, unit) appears in the passage; None when not applicable
value_in_passage.title: Value In Passage

refers_to_product.description: Source is about the identified product (not a look-alike); None for ingredient-level literature
refers_to_product.title: Refers To Product

passage_supports_finding.description: Passage actually states the finding, not just mentions the words
passage_supports_finding.title: Passage Supports Finding

checked_by.description: 'rule', or the reader model id, e.g. 'gemini-flash-lite-latest'
checked_by.title: Checked By

Validation.title: Validation

advertisement.description: Exactly what the ad shows; copied, never edited by the agent

disclaimer.default: This dossier collects and organises sources. It contains no verdict on any claim and is not medical advice. Ingredient-level evidence does not show that the finished product is effective.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
